env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# In a marked module plain go re-executes as logos: the build applies
# logos.toml exactly as logos build does, including the cgo policy.
[cgo] ! logos build -o $WORK/logos$GOEXE ./sub
[cgo] stderr 'restriction::cgo_usage'
[cgo] ! go build -o $WORK/plain$GOEXE ./sub
[cgo] stderr 'restriction::cgo_usage'
[cgo] ! exists $WORK/plain$GOEXE

# The target_cpu setting applies to both spellings of the command.
env GOARCH=arm64
env CGO_ENABLED=0
cd arm
logos build -o $WORK/arm_logos .
go version -m $WORK/arm_logos
stdout 'GOARM64=v8.2'
go build -o $WORK/arm_plain .
go version -m $WORK/arm_plain
stdout 'GOARM64=v8.2'
exec cmp $WORK/arm_logos $WORK/arm_plain

-- go.mod --
module example.com/plain

go 1.27

-- logos.toml --
[project]
strict_files = [".lgo"]
[build]
cgo = "forbid"
cgo_allowlist = []
opt_level = "O3"
target_cpu = "native"
arena = true
[capabilities]
transitive_reflect = "deny"
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"
transitive_unsafe = "deny"
reflect_allowlist = []
transitive_exec_allowlist = []
transitive_net_allowlist = []
transitive_unsafe_allowlist = []
[lints]
correctness = "forbid"
concurrency = "forbid"
slop = "deny"
complexity = "deny"
perf = "deny"
style = "deny"
suspicious = "deny"
portability = "deny"
pedantic = "deny"
[lints.thresholds]
max_nesting_depth = 30
max_cognitive_complexity = 150
max_function_lines = 600
max_function_params = 40
max_comptime_ast_nodes = 40960
max_ctfe_steps = 1000000

-- marker.lgo --
package marker

-- sub/main.go --
package main

/*
static int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println(int(C.answer())) }

-- arm/go.mod --
module example.com/plainarm

go 1.27

-- arm/logos.toml --
[build]
target_cpu = "deterministic"

-- arm/main.go --
package main

func main() {}
